title: Recording: B Side To Seaside by Suzy And The Red Stripes | 1977
content:
Studio Three, Abbey Road Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: Geoff Emerick

Paul and Linda McCartney recorded ‘B Side To Seaside’ on 16 March 1977.

They had initially recorded the song on 18 February, but decided a remake was needed. The song was intended for the flipside of Linda McCartney’s Suzy And The Red Stripes single ‘Seaside Woman’.

On this day the song was taped again from scratch. Paul McCartney recorded the backing track solo, laying down Mellotron, electric guitars, Moog synthesizer, congas, and banjo. Linda then recorded her vocals.

More recording for ‘B Side To Seaside’ took place on 17 and 18 March.
